about: Claude's proposal for Adam's review: which products join the Create your own play picker, under which of Adobe's own menu headings, and in which wave. stands: canvas = in the tool today, oct30 = researched Oct 30 (services and sources written, not on the canvas), new = first read Nov 10. wave: 1 to 4, or out = leave out for now.

drop.cw|bv: A tutorial video page only: Coworker reads Semrush data in a campaign walkthrough. Not a connection a partner sets up.
drop.cw|express: Named only in Coworker for teams, the separate trial application.
drop.aa|bc: Thin: an event callback and one FAQ line, no setup guide. To settle in the wave's own research.
drop.aemforms|target: Indirect: through AEM Sites page targeting.
drop.aemforms|acrobat: AEM 6.5 Forms on JEE only (document security).

bv_words.aa: Brand Visibility connects to an Adobe Analytics report suite and shows what AI-referred visits are worth. In the paid offering.
bv_words.semrush: Semrush Enterprise AIO supplies the data behind Brand Visibility's dashboards, and the Brand Visibility license includes it.
bv_words.cja: Brand Visibility sends AI-agent activity to CJA and reads AI-referred visits and conversions back.
bv_words.commerce: Brand Visibility reads the Commerce catalog to improve product pages for AI assistants.
bv_words.aemsites: Optimize at Edge runs on AEM's Adobe-managed CDN, for AI agents only.
bv_words.eds: Edge fixes reach the AI assistants Adobe supports. Lasting changes are made where the site is authored.
bv_words.bc: No native connector. Partners map the questions Brand Visibility tracks to Brand Concierge's approved sources.

products.name: Semrush
products.note: Its documentation is on semrush.com, which this session cannot open yet.

products.name: Brand Intelligence
products.note: Checks creative work against brand rules. Not about AI search. Needs Firefly Creative Production.

products.name: AEM Forms
products.note: The product in the Washington State RFP.

products.name: AEM Screens
products.note: Adobe's AEM 6.5 LTS notes list Screens as removed, with no replacement. The cloud version continues.

products.name: Adobe Learning Manager
products.note: Not in Adobe's business menu. Its Commerce connector needs it sold as an Experience Manager add-on.

products.name: GenStudio for Commerce Media Networks
products.note: Announced. Adobe has no public documentation for it yet.

products.name: Creative Cloud
products.note: One box for the apps. The partner work is connecting them.

products.name: Firefly Foundry
products.note: Adobe has no public documentation under this name yet.

products.name: Audience Manager
products.note: Adobe publishes a guide for moving from it to Real-Time CDP.

foot: Sources: Adobe's public documentation (Experience League, helpx, developer.adobe.com, aem.live), read on Nov 10 2026. All {quotes} quotes behind this map were checked word for word against the live pages. business.adobe.com cannot be opened from Claude's session, so the product list is Adam's screenshots of Adobe's menu.

A connection counts only when an Adobe page describes it. Tutorial walkthroughs, bare mentions and anything Adobe marks as coming soon are left out. Each wave's own research confirms the connections again before anything is built.
Seen in Adobe's documentation, not on this map: Adobe Marketo Optimizer (a new guide dated Oct 21 2026), Experience Platform as its own box, Journey Optimizer Loyalty and Streaming Media.
The waves and the headings for products outside Adobe's menu are Claude's proposal for Adam's review. Nothing in the tool changes until he says yes.
